{{Quote|The natives's forbidden zone is in sector 22-G.|[[Hael Phirce]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Sector 22-G''' was a designation of a [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] area by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. [[The Imprisoned One]]'s corruption spread through that area during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
